title: Open restriction data for a universal first order thickening
statement: For a universal first order thickening and opens V and U with h(V) ≤ U, there are restricted maps and an open restricted thickening satisfying the compatibility equations and universal property.

source.place: Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FA and Lemma 04F3

proof.text: Apply clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-universal-thickening-open-pieces] to h, i, h′, H, V, U and hVU. It gives V′, iV, hV and hV′, the preimage equality, containment, all three inclusion compatibilities and restricted universality. Reverse the equality hV ≫ U.ι = V.ι ≫ h and reorder the existential witnesses. The equality iV ≫ hV′ = hV is the compatibility conjunct in the definition [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening] applied to the supplied restricted universality. Assemble these witnesses and conjuncts.

source.place: Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FA and Lemma 04F3

proof_origin.place: Proof of Lemma 04F3, general remarks on restriction to opens, as already proved by universalFirstOrderThickening_open_pieces; reordering witnesses and extracting the compatibility conjunct.

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_open_restriction_core
    {Z X Z' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ Z') (h' : Z' ⟶ X)
    (H : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h i h')
    (V : Z.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    ∃ (hV : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme),
      V.ι ≫ h = hV ≫ U.ι ∧ ∃ (V' : Z'.Opens) (iV : V.toScheme ⟶ V'.toScheme)
          (hV' : V'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme),
          i ⁻¹ᵁ V' = V ∧ V' ≤ h' ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧
          iV ≫ V'.ι = V.ι ≫ i ∧ hV' ≫ U.ι = V'.ι ≫ h' ∧
          iV ≫ hV' = hV ∧ IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening hV iV hV'
